summary.text: Evie Brennan is a Republican member of the Wyoming State Senate for District 31 who took office in January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A registered nurse, she faces Democrat Shifa Hamid in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Evie Brennan was born in Cheyenne, Wyoming, graduated from East High School in 2000 and earned a B.S. in nursing from the University of Wyoming in 2004.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as a registered nurse.
Brennan won the 2022 Republican primary for the open seat, defeating Janet Marschner, and assumed office on January 2, 2023.

For 2025-2026 she chaired the Senate Labor, Health and Social Services Committee and was assigned to the Senate Education Committee and the Senate Transportation, Highways and Military Affairs Committee.
She defeated Daniel Singh in the August 18, 2026 Republican primary, 66.2% to 33.8%.
